line.profileNotPublished: {{number}} {{step}} runs a profile that is not published yet
line.toolNotPublished: {{number}} {{step}} runs a tool that is not published yet
line.toolNotRunnable: {{number}} {{step}} runs {{tool}}, which can't run as a step yet

menu.duplicateDraft: Publish it first: a copy starts from a published version.
menu.makeDefaultDraft: Publish it first: New task lists only published pipelines.

rename.label: Pipeline name
rename.hint: Enter to save · Esc to cancel

archived.title: Archived: hidden from the lists and New task
archived.notice: Restore puts {{name}} back in the lists and New task as it was.
archived.noticeOne: Archiving stopped the run that used it, {{runs}}. Restore puts {{name}} back in the lists and New task as it was; that run stays stopped, so run it again to use it.
archived.noticeMany: Archiving stopped {{count}} runs that used it, {{runs}}. Restore puts {{name}} back in the lists and New task as it was; those runs stay stopped, so run them again to use it.
archived.unread: Which runs archiving stopped could not be read. {{reason}}
archived.restoreHint: Back in the lists and New task at once
archived.restoreHintStopped: Back in the lists and New task at once · stopped runs stay stopped

bar.makesFirst: Save makes {{version}} · New task offers it once every step is ready
bar.widenTitle: Allow these changes to the pipeline?
bar.refusedBody: Nothing was saved and what you changed stays here. Save tries again.
bar.keptTitle: Saved as a draft of {{name}}, not published
bar.savedTitle: Saved as {{version}} · the next run uses it

leave.title: Discard the unsaved changes to {{name}}?
leave.what: Opening anything else now puts {{name}} back as it was saved. Keep editing and press Save to keep the changes.
leave.savingWhat: Wait for the save to finish, then press again. Nothing is discarded while it saves.

settings.title: Pipeline
settings.failureSub: A step that stops without a result restarts once, then waits for your decision.

deliverOption.changesSub: Its commits are merged into the base branch.
deliverOption.reportSub: Its last step's report is the result; no repository changes are expected.
deliverOption.outsideSub: Done through MCP tools, e.g. a design or tickets: its report and the tool calls that changed something.
deliverOption.changesOrReportSub: Its commits are merged when it makes any; otherwise its report is the result.

flow.onStartHint: a task with this pipeline starts its run
flow.gateEnd: you approve {{step}} before the run ends
flow.noSteps: No steps yet. Edit steps to add the first one.
flow.toolNotRunnable: {{tool}} can't run as a step yet
flow.endReviewHint: you merge the run from its task
flow.endChangesOrReportHint: you merge its changes, or take its report as the result
flow.endReportHint: the last step's report is the result
flow.endOutsideHint: the last step's report and what its tools changed are the result

branches.title: These steps can't be drawn as one line
branches.detail: A step waits for only part of what runs before it, so no single line shows their order. Edit the steps to see and change what each one waits for.

broken.title: These steps have no order to draw
broken.detail: The steps wait for each other in a circle, or for a step that is not there. Edit the steps to fix what they wait for.

states.newUnavailable: The pipelines can't be read yet, so there is nothing to add to.

all.title: No pipelines yet
all.detail: A pipeline is the steps a task's run goes through: who plans, who builds, who checks, and how it merges.

drafts.title: No drafts
drafts.detail: A new pipeline is a draft until it is first saved.

archived.title: Nothing archived
archived.detail: An archived pipeline leaves the lists and New task's picker, and the runs that use it stop.

ready.title: Ready?
ready.toolNotRunnable: {{tool}} can't run as a step yet
ready.none: No step runs a profile or tool yet
